name: Wonder Guard
description: This Pokemon's body is protected by an incredible otherworldly aura.
effect: This pokemon only takes minimum damage from attacking moves as well as damage from afflicted Status Ailments. Unlike others, this pokemon's HP is not doubled, only being the total of Base HP and Vitality added together. This Ability cannot be swapped, copied, replaced or nullified (ignoring the effects of Skill Swap, Worry Seed, Gastro Acid, Trace etc.)
